o_MX_RZ.nl: Binnen 100 km van de grenzen en 50 km van de kust (de beperkte zone) verwerft een buitenlander woningbezit via een banktrust (fideicomiso) waarvoor een vergunning van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (SRE) nodig is; de trust duurt maximaal 50 jaar en kan worden verlengd.
o_MX_RZ.ru: В пределах 100 км от границ и 50 км от побережья (запретная зона) иностранец приобретает жильё через банковский траст (fideicomiso), для которого нужно разрешение министерства иностранных дел (SRE); траст действует до 50 лет и может быть продлён.
o_MX_RZ.zh: 在距国境 100 公里、距海岸 50 公里的范围内（限制区），外国人须通过银行信托（fideicomiso）取得住宅物业，该信托需外交部（SRE）许可；信托期限最长 50 年，可延期。

o_DOC_TYPES.permit: a building permit or related approval (Indonesia: PBG, old IMB, SLF, KKPR/zoning; elsewhere the local equivalent). Extract permit number, holder, address/plot, permitted use, floors, building area, issue date, issuing office. Flag: holder differs from the developer, use not residential/tourism as sold, more floors/units sold than permitted, permit for a different plot, SLF (fit-for-use) missing for a finished building.
o_DOC_TYPES.contract: a property sale or reservation contract (Indonesia: PPJB, AJB, lease agreement; or any off-plan SPA). Extract parties, property, price, payment schedule, completion date, title type, lease term and extension, penalties for late delivery, refund rights, governing law, who holds the title until transfer. In "clauses" list the clauses that put the buyer at risk (unilateral date changes, no penalty for delay, payments not tied to construction milestones, nominee structures, forfeit of all payments on buyer default, extension "promised" without fixed price, dispute forum far from the buyer).
o_DOC_TYPES.company: a company deed or registration (Indonesia: Akta Pendirian/Perubahan, SK Kemenkumham/AHU, NIB/OSS, PT PMA). Extract company name, deed number and notary, registration numbers, shareholders, directors, authorised business lines (KBLI), capital. Flag: business lines that do not allow selling or renting property, shareholders that look like nominees, company younger than the project it sells, directors who are not the people you deal with.
o_DOC_TYPES.invoice: an invoice, payment request or receipt from a developer or contractor. Extract issuer, bank account holder, amounts, currency, what is being paid for (which milestone), dates. Flag: bank account holder differs from the contracting company, milestone billed that the buyer cannot verify on site, amounts that do not match the payment schedule, personal accounts, crypto or cash requests.
o_DOC_TYPES.certificate: an Indonesian land certificate (SHM, SHGB, Hak Pakai). Extract right type, certificate number, NIB, Surat Ukur, area, location, holder, dates, encumbrances (Hak Tanggungan, blokir). Flag: foreigners cannot hold SHM; SHGB/Hak Pakai expire; mortgages must be lifted before transfer.
o_DOC_TYPES.auto: any document used when buying property abroad. First decide what it is, then extract what matters for a buyer.
